text.card: A star about 14 parsecs away, 1.3 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.3 solar radii and 0.99 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,764 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 47 Ursae Majoris
quotes.card: 47 Ursae Majoris, formally named Chalawan, is a yellow dwarf star approximately 45.3 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: As of 2011, three extrasolar planets are known to orbit the star.
